changes_in_this_release: Editable existing alarms retain IDs, disabled state and scheduling; timer presets/labels retain drafts
Appointments have validated 1–1440 minute duration, readable end times, draft restoration and matching CalendarProvider ends
Legacy appointments/drafts default to 60 minutes; duration-only remote changes display once and all-day dates use local days
Contacts retain details/edit context and refresh after permission return; one recoverable user-authored draft, confirmed discard and safe delayed accepted saves
Pinned Markdown notes move first without modifying document text or other drafts; hold menu and Preview More expose pinning
Calculator starts new numbers after equals, chains operators, explicitly copies/reuses history and retains invalid input
Camera-only Files uses fixed Previous/Share/Next and validates ownership on every selected photo
Messages leads with the active feed; SMS and installed messaging apps are bottom commands
Phone has larger number entry and cursor-aware plus insertion without automatic calls
Existing black/white/accent terminal style, compact headers, hidden individual settings and native Android gestures retained
Same package/signature/permissions; no Internet permission; real handset behaviour remains unverified
retained_features: Pocket Camera-only Files album without modern photo-library permission
Actual notification-reader consent/status and 56 dp Open/Dismiss/footer controls
Task due dates, Important, subtasks, progress, search and Open/Today/Later/Done filters
Local Markdown notes with Markwon previews and hold-to-open native formatting wheel
Android bottom-edge Home/Recents gestures and native predictive internal Back
Optional existing phone-side Google Calendar integration through Android CalendarProvider

android_consent.sms: Default SMS role plus SMS access; sending needs explicit tap and Android permissions
android_consent.notifications: Android notification-reader consent, separate from POST_NOTIFICATIONS
android_consent.restricted_settings: Manual app-info approval if Android offers it; no bypass

privacy.reply_drafts: Only unfinished user-authored compositions, privately, bounded and expiring
privacy.explicit_source_capture: Only a user-selected note/message/share source snapshot/reference is stored with its task, locally
privacy.contact_drafts: One user-authored contact edit plus a bounded local accepted-save reference; no automatic address-book archive

sms_limits: Outgoing MMS/attachment sending and RCS not implemented
Carrier sent state is not recipient delivery/read confirmation
package: Android app source, without private signing keys, caches or local SDK configuration

navigation.home_recents: Android/Nothing OS system gestures and transitions
navigation.own_task_reuse: Component-specific native task flags; source capture/reminder stay in the caller task; Organizer opens exact records in its Today task
navigation.predictive_back: Gesture callback on API 34+; readonly cached parent when available; opaque foreground
navigation.message_hub_children: SMS inbox and notification reply stay in the caller task
navigation.source_capture_and_reminder_children: Private source capture/reminder editors stay in the calling task; public native share has a separate task affinity

release_kind: Signed incremental update; same Android package and signer; install over existing app

previews.kind: Reviewed native Android API 28 layout render with local fixture data, not handset recording

message_hub.received_content: Currently active Android notifications; no automatic received-history archive. Make task explicitly stores a selected source snapshot.
message_hub.transport: Installed WhatsApp/Signal/Telegram/etc. apps handle their own receiving and delivery
message_hub.open: Explicit native notification PendingIntent or installed app launch
message_hub.reply: Explicit freeform RemoteInput when provided by the app; accepted handoff is not delivery confirmation
message_hub.user_composition_drafts: Private local user-authored text only; up to seven days; cleared after handoff

productivity.task_reminder: One-shot exact alarm with stable task ID; reschedule/snooze preserve link; completion/deletion cancels; reopen requires explicit schedule
